Item: Congratulations! Click this link to claim your free phone.
Why It Fits: It uses a prize claim and suspicious link.

Item: Dear class, tomorrow's science quiz starts at 9:00 AM.
Why It Fits: It is a normal classroom message with useful details.

Item: Your password expires today. Confirm it here now.
Why It Fits: It creates urgency and asks for a sensitive action.

Why It Fits: It gives feedback about the lesson.

Item: Comment: I like pizza after school.
Why It Fits: It does not help evaluate the lesson.

Item: Comment: The video was too fast, but the worksheet helped.
The explanation was simple and I understood the topic.

Why It Fits: The student reports confusion and pace problems.

Item: The class was challenging, but the group work helped me improve.
Why It Fits: The overall message says the activity helped learning.

Why It Fits: It meets the expected answer criteria.
